turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Hi there, how are you feeling now after the surgery?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Still a bit groggy, but okay. My tummy is sore, though.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: I understand. Can you rate your pain for me, from 1 to 10?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Hmm, maybe a 4 or 5. It's manageable, but I can feel it.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Thank you. Have you been feeling nauseous or sick to your stomach at all?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: A little bit when I first woke up, but it's better now. Not too bad.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Good. How's your breathing? Any discomfort or feeling like you can't catch your breath?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: No, I'm breathing fine. My throat is a bit sore, but that's all.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: That can happen with the LMA. Do you remember anything from the surgery itself?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: No, nothing. I was out cold. Just woke up here.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: That's expected. Since you have hypertension and diabetes, we'll keep a close eye on your vitals and blood sugar levels. Any concerns from your side?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: No, I think I'm okay. Just want to go home and rest.
